testsuite.name: eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.updater.PolarisApkDownloaderTest

testcase.name: incorrect partial response is never appended or offered for installation()
legacy requests without a digest restart rather than merging unpinned bytes()
server ignoring Range restarts cleanly without appending a second full APK()
cancellation retains written bytes and the next attempt resumes them()
416 with a corrupt partial discards it and requests the full file()
verified APK is reused when the install screen is reopened()
interrupted transfer resumes with a new downloader instance and verifies the entire APK()
another release cannot reuse stale partial bytes()
checksum mismatch removes the candidate and leaves no installable APK()
retryable HTTP error preserves a partial for the next worker attempt()
416 after receiving the final byte promotes only a matching digest()
encoded response is rejected before it changes the partial()
